recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: open-source models finding harbor in silicon valleys
a dark horse model waking in the eastern sky
supersized El Niño swelling on the horizon
wildfire haze drifting across distant horizons
overcast autumn fog at sixteen degrees over the bay
agents spun up from a pocket before sunrise

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Swipe between three fog layers to intercept drifting open-source orbs before they dissolve into the gray bay.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: chain five clean catches in one lane and hear the orbs harmonize into a single pulse
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: orbs fall faster, lanes shuffle positions, wind shears push targets across lanes
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: muted autumn monochrome with occasional neon cyan acquisition flashes

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Draw warm ocean current paths to steer El Niño swell beads into atmospheric pockets before the superswell breaks the shoreline.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: one continuous ribbon routes every bead home in under 45 seconds
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: heat ribbons curl tighter, rogue downdrafts erase drawn paths, target pockets shrink
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: watercolor meteorology map with burnt orange pressure isobars

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Memorize a brief sequence of glowing chip IDs as repos merge, then tap them back in order before the acquisition screen resets.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: recall one flawless four-chip sequence and watch the merger animation complete
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: longer sequences, duplicate decoy chips flash, countdown shrinks
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: schematic board with soft amber merge pulses on slate gray

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Tap only the pulsing words in a scrolling 'imagine 2026' sentence — ignore decoy prompts as the line accelerates through overcast dawn.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: nail one full sentence without a miss and trigger a brief 2026 vision flash
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: scroll speed doubles, homophone decoys appear, punctuation throws off the beat
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: terminal green typewriter on a pre-dawn San Francisco gradient
